# Shopify Reporting MCP Server

[![Phase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Phase-1%20Foundation-blue)](https://github.com/your-org/shopify-reporting-mcp)
[![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3.12%2B-green)](https://www.python.org/)
[![FastMCP](https://img.shields.io/badge/FastMCP-3.2.4-orange)](https://gofastmcp.com)

> **Phase 1: Foundation** — Core infrastructure for multi-store Shopify reporting and analytics via MCP.

## Overview

A production-ready MCP server that provides secure, scalable access to Shopify store data for reporting and analytics. Built on [FastMCP](https://gofastmcp.com) with enterprise-grade security, role-based access control, and structured reporting.

## Quick Start

Clone the repository:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/RaheesAhmed/shopify-mcp-server.git
cd shopify-mcp-server
```

```bash
# Install dependencies
uv sync

# Configure environment
cp .env.example .env
# Edit .env with your Shopify credentials

# Generate encryption key
python -c "from cryptography.fernet import Fernet; print(Fernet.generate_key().decode())"

# Start server
uv run server.py
```

Server runs at `http://localhost:8000` with MCP endpoint at `/mcp`.

## Features

| Feature | Implementation |
|---------|---------------|
| **Multi-Store OAuth** | Shopify OAuth 2.0 with HMAC validation and state management |
| **Token Security** | AES-256 encryption (Fernet) with per-store key scoping |
| **Access Control** | Role-based permissions (agency_admin, client_viewer, internal_admin) |
| **Metrics** | 21 pre-defined Shopify metrics across 7 categories |
| **Reporting** | JSON and Markdown output formatters |
| **Logging** | Structured logging with request tracing |
| **Error Handling** | Standardized error codes with detailed context |

## Architecture

```
shopify-reporting-mcp/
├── server.py              # MCP server bootstrap
├── auth/                  # Authentication & authorization
│   ├── encryption.py      # AES-256 token encryption
│   ├── oauth.py           # Shopify OAuth 2.0 flow
│   └── rbac.py            # Role-based access control
├── database/              # Data persistence
│   ├── connection.py      # SQLite connection pool
│   └── migrations.py      # Schema migrations (v1-v5)
├── metrics/               # Metric definitions
│   └── registry.py        # 21 Shopify metrics
├── models/                # Data models
│   ├── entities.py        # Client, Store entities
│   └── audit.py           # Audit log models
├── formatters/            # Report output
│   ├── json_formatter.py  # JSON reports
│   └── markdown_formatter.py  # Markdown reports
├── tools/                 # MCP tools
│   └── shopify.py         # Shopify integration tools
└── utils/                 # Utilities
    ├── logging.py         # Structured logging
    └── errors.py          # Error handling
```

## Configuration

### Required Variables

```bash
# Shopify App
SHOPIFY_API_KEY=your_api_key
SHOPIFY_API_SECRET=your_api_secret
SHOPIFY_APP_URL=https://your-app.com

# OAuth
OAUTH_REDIRECT_URL=https://your-app.com/auth/callback
OAUTH_SCOPES=read_orders,read_products,read_customers,read_analytics

# Security
ENCRYPTION_KEY=your_fernet_key_here=  # 32-byte base64
JWT_SECRET=your_jwt_secret

# Server
HOST=0.0.0.0
PORT=8000
LOG_LEVEL=INFO
```

### Optional Variables

```bash
DATABASE_URL=sqlite+aiosqlite:///data/shopify_mcp.db
JWT_ALGORITHM=HS256
JWT_EXPIRATION_HOURS=24
```

## API Reference

### MCP Tools

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `shopify_validate_store` | Validate Shopify store domain |
| `shopify_get_auth_url` | Generate OAuth authorization URL |
| `shopify_list_metrics` | List all available metrics |
| `shopify_get_metric_definition` | Get metric details by ID |
| `shopify_search_metrics` | Search metrics by name |
| `shopify_generate_json_report` | Generate JSON report |
| `shopify_generate_markdown_report` | Generate Markdown report |
| `shopify_list_roles` | List RBAC roles |
| `shopify_server_status` | Get server status |

### MCP Resources

| URI | Description |
|-----|-------------|
| `config://app-settings` | Server configuration |
| `status://health` | Health status |
| `metrics://definitions` | All metric definitions |
| `rbac://roles` | Role permissions |

### HTTP Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| GET | `/health` | Health check |
| GET | `/metrics` | List metrics |
| GET | `/metrics/{id}` | Get metric |
| GET | `/auth/shopify?shop={domain}` | OAuth init |
| GET | `/auth/callback` | OAuth callback |

## Metrics Reference

### Sales
- `total_sales` — Total revenue including taxes and shipping
- `net_sales` — Sales minus discounts and returns
- `average_order_value` — Average value per order

### Orders
- `total_orders` — Order count
- `orders_by_status` — Orders grouped by status
- `conversion_rate` — Session to order percentage

### Products
- `total_products` — Active product count
- `top_selling_products` — Best performing products
- `product_inventory_value` — Total inventory value

### Customers
- `total_customers` — Unique customers
- `new_customers` — First-time customers
- `returning_customers` — Repeat customers
- `customer_lifetime_value` — Average customer spend

### Inventory
- `inventory_quantity` — Total units in stock
- `low_stock_products` — Below threshold count
- `inventory_turnover` — Stock replacement rate

### Analytics
- `sessions` — Website sessions
- `page_views` — Total page views

### Finance
- `total_refunds` — Refund amount
- `total_discounts` — Discount amount
- `gross_profit` — Net sales minus COGS

## Access Control

### Roles

| Role | Permissions |
|------|-------------|
| `agency_admin` | Full store management, report creation, data access |
| `client_viewer` | Read-only access to assigned stores |
| `internal_admin` | Full system access |

### Permission Types

```python
# Store management
STORE_CONNECT, STORE_DISCONNECT, STORE_VIEW, STORE_LIST

# Reports
REPORT_VIEW, REPORT_CREATE, REPORT_EXPORT, REPORT_SCHEDULE

# Data access
DATA_ORDERS, DATA_PRODUCTS, DATA_CUSTOMERS, DATA_ANALYTICS, DATA_INVENTORY

# Admin
ADMIN_MANAGE_USERS, ADMIN_MANAGE_ROLES, ADMIN_AUDIT_LOGS
```

## Report Formats

### JSON
```json
{
  "report": {
    "metadata": {
      "title": "Monthly Sales Report",
      "generated_at": "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z",
      "store_name": "My Store"
    },
    "data": {
      "total_sales": 12500.00,
      "total_orders": 150
    }
  }
}
```

### Markdown
```markdown
# Monthly Sales Report

## Report Information
- **Generated:** 2024-01-15 10:30:00 UTC
- **Store:** My Store

## Summary
| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Total Sales | $12,500.00 |
| Total Orders | 150 |
```
